visual.general_description: Eye-movement recording chart titled "DOWNBEAT NYSTAGMUS" with two stacked traces labelled H and V and a 1 sec scale bar.

Below is a recording grid with vertical and horizontal grid lines and two stacked traces drawn in dark lines over faint gray shadows. visual.general_description: Two H&E-style microscopy panels of cerebellar cortex: A with an arrowhead and a row of larger cells, B without them.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A (left, letter printed) and panel B (right, letter printed) show similar pink tissue with a dense purple small-nucleus band. Panel A has one black arrowhead pointing to one of a row of larger cell bodies; panel B has no arrowhead and no such row, with scattered clear spaces in the lower region. Neither panel has a visible scale bar or printed text beyond the panel letters.

panels.general_description: Panel A: H&E-style cerebellar cortex section with a black arrowhead and a row of larger cell bodies at the layer interface.
panels.detailed_description: Hematoxylin and eosin style pink tissue with scattered small purple nuclei fills the upper and left parts. A band of densely packed small dark-purple nuclei lies along the lower right. At the interface between the pink layer and the dense purple layer is a row of larger pink-purple cell bodies, and one black arrowhead points to one of these larger cells. A pale gap at the upper left corner marks the tissue edge. The letter "A" is printed at the upper left.

visual.general_description: Composite vHIT screenshot titled "vHIT Patient 2 Anti-Yo antibody": a gain scatter display on the left and two head/eye velocity trace plots labelled Left Lateral and Right Lateral.
visual.detailed_description: A title line printed at the upper left reads "vHIT Patient 2 Anti-Yo antibody". The left third is a software screen with tab labels "Gain", "Info", "Remarks", "Test", "Display" and "Reanalysis", a small legend with blue LL and red RL entries and printed numeric text, and "Relative Asymmetry" with a printed percentage. Below is a gain plot with y-axis label "Gain" and x-axis label "Peak Velocity (deg/s)", showing a cluster of dark-red dots with a larger red X marker and a cluster of blue dots with a larger blue X marker, plus pairs of curved red and blue lines; the plot area has a white section and a gray-shaded section. The middle plot is titled "Left Lateral" with a legend of Head (blue), Saccade (red) and VOR (green); y-axis label "Head & Eye Velocity", x-axis label "Left Lateral (LL) ms". Many overlaid blue, green and red traces form a dominant rising and falling shape, with a thick black trace, and one thick black arrow points to a narrow dark-red saccade peak. The right plot is titled "Right Lateral" with the same legend, y-axis label "Head & Eye Velocity", x-axis label "Right Lateral (RL) ms", overlaid blue/orange, green and red traces with a similar rising and falling shape and no arrow. A small rounded home-like icon overlay is at the right edge. No calendar date or time stamp is visible.
